from urllib3.response import ContentDecoder
import io

# In 2.5.0, custom decompressors inherited from ContentDecoder
# with a specific API that has changed in 2.6.0
class CustomDecoder(ContentDecoder):
    def __init__(self):
        # Old initialization pattern
        pass
    
    def decompress(self, data):
        return data

# Attempt to instantiate with old API expectations
decoder = CustomDecoder()
# The old API would work here in 2.5.0
result = decoder.decompress(b"test")
assert result == b"test"
title: ContentDecoder API change for custom decompressors
